title: That time of the week
description: 🌍 Feeling the Minecraft phase coming back? Now’s the perfect time to join the server!
body:
# 🌙 MC-Phase

> A Minecraft project inspired by the **Minecraft Phase**.

You know the cycle:

🎮 Suddenly you want to play Minecraft again  
⛏️ You play for a week or two  
🛌 Then you take a break  
🔁 Later… the phase returns

**MC-Phase embraces that cycle.**

Jump in when the urge to play hits.  
Take a break when it fades.  
The world will still be here when you return.

---

## ✨ What to Expect

- 🧱 Relaxed gameplay
- 🏗️ Build whatever you want
- 🌍 Explore and experiment
- 👥 Players coming and going naturally

No pressure. Just play when the **phase** returns.

---

## 🚀 The Idea

Many Minecraft players experience waves of activity.  
MC-Phase is built around that idea — play when you're excited, step away when you're not.

Simple as that.

---

## 🔄 The MC-Phase Cycle

```
Want to play → Join the server → Build & explore → Take a break → Phase returns
```

And the cycle begins again.

---

## 🟢 Join When the Phase Hits

Whether it's your **first phase** or your **tenth**,  
**MC-Phase** is ready when you are.

⛏️ Build.  
🌍 Explore.  
🔁 Come back anytime.
